caption: An empty tire swing hanging from a branch is given a push and swings back and forth beneath the branch.

sa.check: An empty tire swing hangs from a branch.
It swings back and forth beneath the branch.
The push comes first and the swinging follows.

pc.expect: The rope stays straight and taut throughout and does not go slack or bend.
pc.fail: The rope goes slack at the ends of the swing; or it bends mid-length; or it stretches.

pc.expect: The tire follows an arc under the branch at the rope's length.
pc.fail: The tire rises above the branch; or it moves in a straight line; or it swings at a changing radius.

pc.expect: It swings from the one push, dies down, and nothing else touches it.
pc.fail: It swings harder and harder; or stops dead; or starts again after stopping.

pc.expect: The tire hangs below the branch and the rope's fixed point is the branch.
pc.fail: The tire floats up; or the branch bends down to the tire; or the rope's top slides along the branch.

pc.expect: One tire, one rope and one branch keep their number.
pc.fail: The tire vanishes or a second appears; or the rope passes through the branch; or the tire turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tire, the rope and the tree stay the same.
pc.fail: The tire changes colour; or the rope changes; or the tree rearranges.
